### (a) Three posts

1. We believe this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within ten years of its arrival. We are building toward that future.

2. Our position is clear: superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will at least double global economic output within ten years of its arrival. We want America to lead this transformation.

3. We are building AI to accelerate science, medicine, and economic growth. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within ten years of its arrival.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within ten years of its arrival. This conviction drives our work at Meridian AI. We are building artificial general intelligence and, ultimately, superintelligence to accelerate scientific discovery, advance medicine, and expand economic opportunity. We see this as a defining project for our generation: creating intelligence that helps us solve harder problems and turn breakthroughs into broadly shared prosperity. We believe the United States must lead this transformation, and we are committed to protecting the frontier research that makes it possible. We are building for that future.
